description: Diamond Industries Limited was incorporated on 18 June 1989 as Diamond Industries (Private) Limited, began commercial production on 11 November 1989, and was converted into a public limited company on 3 August 1994. Its principal activity is the manufacture and sale of foam products and PVA products for industrial and domestic use, from its works on the 23-km Multan Road at Mohlanwal, Lahore.
headOffice: 23-km, Multan Road, Mohlanwal, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.dil.com.pk/ (incorporation, start of production and conversion to a public company, registered address) and the exchange's company record at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/DIIL (principal activity of foam and PVA products, and the chief executive) — the same activity statement appears in the company's own filing at https://psx.com.pk/psx/file-attachment/189102.pdf. Telephone is as printed on the company's PSX correspondence (042-111-111-666) (accessed 2026-10-17)
